title: Program Manager, Selling Partner Experience Core Services
description:
We are looking for an exceptionally organized, self-motivated Program Manager to serve as a force multiplier for the Selling Partner Experience Core Services (SPECS) organization, part of Customer Selling Partner Experience (CSPE). This role blends strategic program management with site operations leadership and community engagement, offering significant ownership, autonomy, and organizational impact.
You will run cross-functional initiatives, turn strategic direction into executable plans, and drive the operational rhythms that keep our organization aligned, moving fast, and having fun. As the primary point of contact for Phoenix site activities across the VP-level CSPE organization, you will also lead community engagement efforts including volunteer programs and local partnerships.
Day to day, you will apply project management best practices to make your team and process area more efficient. This means defining clear milestones and launch schedules, assigning individual responsibilities, resolving blockers, and facilitating delivery. You will transform raw ideas into clear documentation and requirements, and ensure every project has well-defined measures of success.
A key focus of this role is keeping leadership and the broader team organized, informed, and on task. Calendar management and scheduling at a high level will require extremely high standards, attention to detail, and superb organizational skills. You should be comfortable juggling multiple priorities, and managing last-minute escalations with grace.
The ideal candidate is a self-starter with a positive attitude who is passionate about employee experience, community involvement, and making the people around them more effective. Clear, concise communication, both written and verbal, is essential.
Key job responsibilities
Organizational Effectiveness & Business Operations
• Own and drive critical business review cadences including Weekly Business Reviews (WBRs) and Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs): agenda creation, pre-reads, action item tracking, and follow-through.
• Own the SPECS tech roadmap planning cycles: quarterly planning, OP1/OP2, and PI Planning
• Track organizational commitments, surface risks early, and ensure delivery against roadmap milestones
• Prepare leadership communications including monthly flash updates, org-wide announcements, and information radiators
• Coordinate leadership off-sites, all-hands meetings, and strategic planning sessions
Site Operations & Leadership Support
• Serve as the primary point of contact for all PHX site-related activities for the SPECS organization and the VP-level CSPE organization based in Phoenix
• Oversee site support functions and establish infrastructure for continued site growth
• Coordinate with facilities, IT, and corporate functions on space planning, site logistics, and site-level communications
• Identify site-wide learning and development opportunities; coordinate training programs and evaluate effectiveness
Community Engagement & Employee Experience
• Lead community engagement activities for the PHX CSPE presence
• Identify and coordinate volunteer opportunities with local organizations and community partners
• Build relationships with community leaders, universities (ASU, UofA), and local technology groups
• Coordinate external events including career fairs, hackathons, networking events, and sponsorship opportunities
• Drive initiatives that strengthen Amazon's local reputation and support recruiting pipelines
• Lead employee experience programs: social events, recognition programs, and culture-building activities
A day in the life
No two days in this role look exactly the same, but they all center on keeping people aligned, informed, and moving forward. Here is what a typical week might look like.
Your mornings often start by reviewing action items from recent Weekly or Monthly Business Reviews, following up with engineering leads, product managers, and operations partners across the SPECS organization to keep commitments on track. You may spend part of your morning preparing a pre-read document for an upcoming leadership review or drafting a monthly flash update that distills complex program status into clear, actionable takeaways for VP-level stakeholders within CSPE.
Midday, you might shift to site operations: connecting with facilities and IT on a space-planning request for the growing Phoenix site, coordinating logistics for an upcoming all-hands meeting, or reviewing proposals for a new training program. You are the go-to person when anyone in the PHX office needs to know who to call, what is happening on-site, or how to get something done.
In the afternoon, you could be working with local universities like ASU or UofA to finalize details for a career fair, aligning with community partners on a volunteer event, or planning the next employee recognition activity. You balance these external-facing efforts with internal collaboration, partnering with Executive Assistants across Amazon Payments to coordinate leadership calendars and resolve scheduling conflicts.

Selling Partner Experience Core Services (SPECS) is part of the Customer Selling Partner Experience (CSPE) organization, responsible for the core systems and capabilities that enable millions of sellers to list and manage their products on Amazon. Our Phoenix site is a growing hub of product, engineering, and operations talent, and this role is central to ensuring we scale effectively while maintaining a strong culture and community presence.

title: RFID Store Design/Operations Engineer, RFID Program Management
description:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.
Amazon Just Walk Out (JWO) is changing the world of retail shopping with new technology solutions that provide shoppers with a better in-store experience and gets them back to the action sooner, and provides retailers more throughput and better analytics, allowing them to run their stores more efficiently. JWO launched its first RFID- technology in 2024 and the business has been growing rapidly across sports stadiums, pop-up sporting events, and concert tours.
JWO’s RFID technologies really change the way stores operate both in-store and back-of-house. Customers need help adapting their infrastructure, tools, and operations to maximize the value they can extract from JWO’s RFID technologies. The RFID Program Management Team seeks an innovative, solutions-oriented, and process-minded engineer to lead a program that works directly with customers, and between product, engineering, and operations teams, to define optimal end-to-end RFID solutions that meet a customer’s unique in-store and back-of-house needs.
To be successful in this role you will need to be able to quickly learn the business and operational demands of our customers across different business verticals, and reliably define the right complement of RFID-based solutions that deliver demonstrable customer value. You will work directly between sales and implementation teams to define, adhere to, and enforce store launch processes that quickly gather customer requirements and transform them into implementable RFID solutions that can be deployed quickly. You will be challenged; you will learn; you will work on high-impact & high-visibility projects; you will grow.
Key job responsibilities
• Understand the business/operational needs and challenges of JWO’s RFID customers, across our current verticals
• Stay current on the features and benefits of JWO’s latest RFID products and tools, as well as their constraints and limitations
• Provide RFID customers the right (in-store and back-of-house) RFID solution the first time, proven with quantitative before/after data
• Adhere to, enforce, and improve our store configuration and launch process, in partnership with sales and implementation teams
• Identify any gaps in JWO’s RFID product offering and escalate them to our product team for short-term mitigations and long-term solutions
• Present customer learnings, process improvements, program updates, and strategic roadmaps to senior leadership on a regular basis using strong written and verbal communication skills.
• 25% expected travel based on business needs

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

description:
We are seeking a strategic, analytically rigorous Senior Benchmarking and Strategy Program Manager to join the AMXL Global Benchmarking team. This role goes beyond study execution — you will own the end-to-end benchmarking lifecycle from intake through partnered implementation, lead complex multi-stakeholder studies, develop frameworks and methodologies, and translate competitive insights into actionable recommendations that influence operational strategy across a global logistics network. You will serve as a thought leader within the program, shaping the portfolio roadmap, mentoring peers, and driving cross-functional alignment to ensure benchmarking insights result in measurable business outcomes. This is an ideal role for someone who combines deep analytical capability with strategic thinking, stakeholder influence, and a passion for competitive intelligence.
Key job responsibilities
- Portfolio & Study Leadership: Own and lead end-to-end competitive benchmarking studies — from scoping and methodology design through execution, analysis, and recommendation development, across multiple concurrent workstreams spanning delivery experience, customer journey, returns, packaging, service quality and more.
- Methodology Development: Design and refine research methodologies including vendor/carrier interviews, competitive journey mapping, and phase-gated infrastructure assessments to ensure rigorous, repeatable, and scalable study frameworks.
- Strategic Recommendations & Influence: Synthesize complex findings into clear, actionable recommendations with quantified business impact; present to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive investment decisions and operational changes.
- Cross-Functional Program Management: Lead working relationships with stakeholders across Customer Experience, Operations, Learning and Development, Packaging Strategy, Returns, and Services teams to ensure recommendations move from insight to implementation.
- Implementation Tracking & Accountability: Own the connection between benchmarking output and operational action — track recommendation implementation, measure impact, and report progress to leadership through regular business reviews.
- Roadmap & Intake Management: Shape the benchmarking portfolio roadmap by evaluating incoming study requests, prioritizing based on strategic value and business impact, and managing the team's intake pipeline to balance capacity with demand.
- Knowledge Systems & Competitive Intelligence: Build and maintain scalable knowledge management systems that make competitive intelligence accessible, current, and actionable for partners across the organization.
- Stakeholder Engagement & Communication: Host regular engagement forums (office hours, working groups, stakeholder reviews) to share findings, gather feedback, and maintain alignment across a broad partner ecosystem.
- Mentorship & Team Development: Provide guidance and thought partnership to junior team members, elevating the quality of study execution and analytical rigor across the team.

The Opportunity
For a decade, WorkSpaces has been exceptional at what it was designed to do: securely deliver a virtual desktop where a user logs in, applications load, work happens, the session ends. It is reactive by design—with no memory of what occurred, no understanding of intent, and no ability to act on the user's behalf. But work has changed. The modern enterprise now runs on three workforces: humans who set direction, AI agents that execute delegated work, and the systems that run the business. Non-human identities already outnumber human ones, yet no infrastructure layer governs all three within a single trust boundary. Whoever solves this—making the secure, governed path the fastest path—will define how the world works for the next decade.
Amazon WorkSpaces is uniquely positioned to lead this transformation. We are extending its trust boundary from humans to humans and AI agents working together, governed by default. This is not an incremental improvement but a reimagining of the workspace itself—from a platform that delivers applications and compute into one that actively partners with users: understanding intent, orchestrating workflows across systems, anticipating needs, and reducing friction at every step.
We are looking for a seasoned product leader to own the end-to-end product strategy for Amazon WorkSpaces and define the future of work at the intersection of human talent and agentic AI. You are a builder-operator who has shipped transformative products at scale and run them in production at enterprise grade. You make bold bets and validate them with data. title: Sr. TPM - Sustainability, Technical Standards - WWGS
description:
We are looking for an innovative leader to join Amazon's WWGS retail and industrial development team who is passionate about reducing the environmental impact of the buildings that serve our customers. The ideal candidate will have a strong knowledge of sustainable building practices, carbon accounting, and their application in retail and grocery industrial environments. This position will be responsible for defining sustainable buildings strategy, embedding the Sustainable Building Standard (SBS) into design standards, and leading retrofits and pilots that reduce carbon and water use. You will also own carbon tracking and reporting, from abatement calculations to embodied carbon and bi-annual forecasts.
This position will be part of an exciting, fast-moving business unit, where everyone on the team needs to be entrepreneurial, wear many hats and work effectively in a highly collaborative environment. You will drive initiatives through design, construction, critical infrastructure and operations teams, and translate Worldwide Sustainability goals into WWGS strategy. You are the right person for this job if you prioritize real decarbonization over offsets and have a passion for producing high-quality, data-driven work. You must take ownership of your work, display a great deal of initiative, possess common sense, sound judgment, and a sense of humor.
Key job responsibilities
- Define and drive the sustainable buildings strategy for WWGS. Put decarbonization ahead of offsets, in line with the Climate Pledge.
- Build the Sustainable Building Standard (SBS) into design standards, specifications and reference documents for every building type and project stage. Track and report SBS compliance for new sites, both at design and at construction complete.
- Lead strategy for sustainable retrofit projects and high-value pilots that cut carbon emissions and water use. Pilots should be pay for themselves through positive lifecycle value.

title: AIML - Sr Machine Learning Platform Engineer, Evaluation
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced machine learning engineer to join AIML Evaluation to build the systems that evaluate and refine Apple's foundation models and agents.
As a key member of the team, you will help design and develop benchmarks, evaluators, simulation environments, and prompt and context optimization pipelines that drive quality improvements across Apple's AI experiences.
You will collaborate with product teams and the foundation model team to close the loop between observation and improvement, contributing datasets, environments, and reward signals that drive model and agent quality.
Most model evaluation stops at a scorecard. The failing traces get thrown away, even though they're the most relevant training signal we have. Our team puts them to work. We evaluate across offline benchmarks, device-in-the-loop simulation, and on-device observation in production, and we turn what we find into persona-grounded datasets and reward signals for foundation model post-training.
In this role, you will build the systems that connect failure analysis to measurable model and agent improvements across a broad range of AI products at Apple. The path from finding a problem to fixing it is short: the loop you build finds the failure, produces the data and checks the result. The work reaches millions of users.
Minimum qualifications: Strong background in machine learning and distributed systems.
A proven track record of solving ambiguous problems end to end: defining the problem and the metric, building the solution, and showing measured impact.
Experience leading technical work across multiple codebases, teams, and organizations.
Experience building and maintaining ML infrastructure for evaluation, training, or deployment.
6+ years of professional experience as a software engineer, preferably in machine learning or a related field. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Preferred qualifications: Experience with LLM evaluation, LLM-as-judge, or reward modeling.
Experience with prompt optimization, agent harness development, or post-training (SFT, DPO, RLHF).
Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX.
Experience with agentic systems, simulation environments, or trajectory-based data generation.
Familiarity with on-device or privacy-preserving ML.
Understanding of how training data is used in post-training and how data choices affect model behavior.
Excellent communication skills.

title: Cellular ASIC Design Engineer
description:
Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other’s ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It’s the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you’ll do more than join something — you’ll add something.
Do you excel at crafting elegant solutions to complex challenges? Do you naturally prioritize the significance of every detail? As a member of our Hardware Technologies group, you'll contribute to designing, optimizing, and manufacturing our next-generation, high-performance, power-efficient cellular chips and system-on-chips (SoC). Your role will be pivotal in ensuring that Apple products and services can seamlessly and efficiently handle the tasks that make them beloved by millions. By joining this group, you'll be responsible for developing and building the technology that powers Apple's devices. We invite you to join us in delivering the next groundbreaking Apple products!
As a Cellular ASIC Design Engineer, you'll develop and optimize design and implementation methodology for integrated circuits across multiple focus areas including area efficiency, power optimization, and design technology co-optimization. You'll design innovative products at the block/IP-level and system-level in advanced process technologies (3nm, 2nm and beyond).
Your primary responsibilities will involve developing best-in-methodologies for optimizing Power, Performance, Area, and Cost efficiency metrics through various approaches:
DESIGN FLOW & METHODOLOGY DEVELOPMENT:
- Establish design guidelines, methodologies, and standards for synthesis, place-and-route, timing closure, and signoff processes
- Develop and optimize EDA tool flows including synthesis tools (DC/DCT/DCG/Genus/Oasis), P&R tools (ICC2/Fusion/Innovus/Aprisa), and signoff tools (PT/PT-SI/Tempus)
- Drive timing convergence process improvements across design teams to enhance design PPA and yield
- Create and maintain comprehensive design flows, scripts, and automation tools to improve design productivity and reduce turnaround time
PHYSICAL DESIGN & IMPLEMENTATION:
- Identify utilization bottlenecks in physical design and develop architectural, design, and implementation-level solutions to improve utilizations
- Work with physical design teams on timing closure, collaborating with CAD teams, IP teams and Design Technology teams for flow scripts/tools development and validation
- Understand RTL to GDS digital flow and provide hands-on contribution for timing signoff of complex SOCs
ANALYSIS & VALIDATION:
- Perform design technology co-optimization analysis, including optimal operating point analysis for performance/power curves and identification of scaling trends and bottlenecks in advanced technology nodes
- Conduct Spice simulations (Hspice/Finesim/AFS/Spectre/Infinisim) for PVT corners validation and STA vs spice correlation
- Perform timing package validation across advanced process technologies and timing signoff specification development
- Conduct in-depth analysis of design databases and silicon validation data to identify critical issues and improve overall design metrics
- Understand intricate timing paths (digital, analog, mixed signal) and timing constraints, providing solutions as required
POWER & PERFORMANCE OPTIMIZATION:
- Develop and implement voltage scaling and power optimization methodologies including clock gating, power gating, and dynamic voltage/frequency scaling techniques
- Use power analysis tools (RedHawk/SeaHawk/Voltus) for comprehensive power signoff and optimization
- Facilitate and drive STA methodology improvements using industry-leading timing tools and ECO methodologies
MULTI-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION:
- Collaborate closely with technology and IP teams to enhance efficiency through custom and semi-custom IP development
- Work closely with process technology, front-end design, physical implementation, CAD, and multi-functional teams to develop innovative solutions
- Support advanced process technology bring-up from PDK to VLSI design production
- Drive DFT (Design for Test) methodology improvements including scan insertion, ATPG, and built-in self-test strategies
TECHNICAL LEADERSHIP:
- Stay ahead of industry trends and emerging technologies to continuously improve design methodologies
- Apply strong programming skills (Python, Perl, TCL, Unix shell, C/C++) for methodology automation and enhancement
- Apply ML modeling experience for advanced design optimization and predictive analysis
Minimum qualifications: Minimum BS and 10+ years of relevant industry experience.
VLSI background with hands-on experience in RTL to GDSII flows.
Prior experience in doing Power, Performance, Area and Cost optimizations for SoCs.
Experience with SoC power flows & Vmin optimization.
Experience with Design Technology Co-optimization, identifying and solving scaling bottlenecks in new technology nodes.
Rapid prototyping and scripting of methodologies and test chip block implementation.
Preferred qualifications: Solid understanding of Physical Design challenges, proficiency with synthesis, place and route tools, and implementation exploration.
Experience with Metal stack optimizations.
Experience performing Early Tech node analysis to identify implementation bottlenecks.
Design Technology Co-optimization expertise.
Strong analytical skills and ability to identify and communicate high return on investment opportunities.
Ability to apply data science and ML analytics for Frontend and Backend databases, as well as post-silicon data, to identify trends & patterns and fine-tune implementation methodologies.

title: Cellular Performance Engineer
description:
In the Wireless Technologies group, you will be responsible for bringing groundbreaking cellular and satellite connectivity to the world. You will design, develop, and patent the next generation of our state-of-the-art wireless technologies. You will collaborate across departments to help craft solutions that elevate the customer experience with Apple products and services. Our goal is to ensure that nothing hinders our customers’ connections with their devices. If you join us, you will help build world-renowned wireless systems so seamless that they almost feel like magic. The wireless software performance team is striving for innovative ways to utilize cellular technologies to enable new services and products that surprise and delight our customers. We are seeking an experienced engineer chartered to build cellular performance labs; play a major role in the architecture, design, and enhancement of new communication technologies and products. You will work on a team that will drive new initiatives within the company and the industry, focused on end-user experience.
Apple is seeking an engineer who can lead and drive characterization of wireless software performance in labs and beyond. Develop expertise in cellular systems, RF frontends, hardware, and software by benchmarking power and performance for Apple products. Act as a liaison between technology and product engineering teams as a gatekeeper of end-user-facing quality. This is an excellent opportunity to interact cross-functionally with multiple engineering groups while bringing in fresh ideas to evangelize wireless communication technologies across Apple’s product portfolio and simultaneously working towards design wins in a data-driven manner from prototyping to commercialization.
Minimum qualifications: Experience working in a laboratory environment, testing and benchmarking data, voice and application performance of cellular systems.
Deep understanding of cellular 3GPP standards relating to 5G NR and LTE, with demonstrated experience with higher-layer protocols such as TCP/IP.
Strong ability to debug and analyze issues across all (L1/L2/L3/Application) layers of the protocol stack, as well as RF frontends.
Experience proposing software optimizations and improvements based on performance data to enhance overall product quality and user experience.
Experience required working with cellular call boxes and channel emulators in a laboratory setting.
Strong knowledge of Python scripting is necessary to automate performance test suites in the laboratory and develop tools and scripts to design key performance indicators (KPIs) required to benchmark product performance.
Preferred qualifications:
Strong collaboration and communication skills across multidisciplinary teams.
Excellent problem-solving skills with a track record of delivering results in fast-paced environments.
Thrive in a collaborative environment, communicate clearly while confidently driving multiple projects across various teams.
Adapt to new technologies, think outside the box, and propose technology and product improvements in a data-driven manner.
Obsessively passionate, inquisitive, and seek to solve everyday problems in innovative ways.

title: Cellular RF System Architect
description:
At Apple, our work is dedicated to creating products that connect and enrich people's lives. The Cellular RF Systems Engineering team sits at the very core of that mission, defining the wireless technologies that enable seamless experiences for hundreds of millions of users worldwide.
We are looking for a motivated and dedicated engineer to join our team and contribute to our Cellular RF architectures. In this role, you will be at the center of RF innovation, helping to drive the evolution of our RF architecture by optimizing current systems, defining next-generation transceiver and front-end solutions and setting critical system requirements.
In your role as the Cellular RF System Architect you will contribute and be part of an elite Cellular RF Systems Engineering Team. We are tasked with driving cellular radio technologies addressing GSM, UMTS, LTE, 5G NR and upcoming 6G standards. You will work closely with Platform Architecture, RFIC and PMU design teams, and suppliers to assess, scope, and ultimately drive Cellular RF technology innovation to meet the challenges of next generation wireless products. Occasional travel including international may be required.
Minimum qualifications: BS and a minimum of 10 years relevant industry experience
You have experience in deriving implementation requirements based on high level system requirements.
You have strong analytical, interpersonal and communication skills with a proven ability to work across diverse, cross-functional teams to solve highly complex, multi-disciplinary problems.
You have strong Technical Writing Skills.
Preferred qualifications: We value your 5+ years of relevant experience in RF including direct expertise in transmitter and receiver architectures. You should never be satisfied with your knowledge so continuous study, research and collaboration is needed from you to grow.
You have in-depth knowledge of cellular radio standards (GSM, UMTS, LTE, 5GNR and upcoming 6G), regulatory, and carrier requirements including their implications on overall radio architectures and RF system design.
You have experience in RF performance criteria and concepts such as EIRP, TRP, noise figure, sensitivity/desense, phase noise, EVM, spectral mask, spurious, harmonics, intermodulation, s-parameters, Smith charts, and tuning networks.
You have experience in RF line-up analysis, AGC and TPC concepts, calibration and compensation methods.
You have experience in understanding complex system use cases and derive corresponding implementation requirements for optimum user experience.
You have understanding of antenna array theory and associated measurement methods.

title: Cellular Software Enablement Engineer, Wireless Technologies & Ecosystems
description:
Do you want to bring new cellular modems to life inside Apple devices? Do you enjoy working across hardware, firmware, and machine learning to solve problems no one has solved yet? Join us to help deliver the cellular connectivity at the heart of our devices. The Cellular Software & Technologies organization builds and optimizes Apple's in-house cellular software. Within this organization, the Cellular CoreBSP Enablement team brings up firmware on every new cellular modem Apple designs and integrates it into every Apple product that ships with cellular connectivity, from first boot through production readiness and commercialization. We are looking for a hands-on engineer to join this high-visibility team in Santa Clara Valley. This role demands someone who fights for excellence in everything they build, drives what matters by focusing on the highest-impact problems, and fosters trust through transparent communication with partners across the organization.
As a member of the Cellular CoreBSP Enablement team, you will own product bring-up of cellular modems in new Apple devices, from early builds through production readiness, and support bring-up of new modems from pre-silicon emulation through post-silicon hardware. You will lead hands-on debugging across the full hardware and software stack and maintain the device labs and development hardware. You will also develop machine learning models that optimize how cellular firmware runs on the platform, working with data providers and use-case teams from problem definition through on-device deployment.
Minimum qualifications: BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, and 2 years of relevant industry experience; or MS in a related field.
Proficiency in C/C++ and in Python or other scripting languages, with experience in embedded systems and RTOS environments.
Coursework or hands-on experience in machine learning, including training and evaluating models with frameworks such as PyTorch, scikit-learn, or XGBoost.
Preferred qualifications: Demonstrated ability to collaborate across teams, communicate technical information clearly, and drive results with minimal guidance.
Hands-on experience debugging embedded systems using JTAG, LLDB, trace tools, or similar.
Experience with product, board, or silicon bring-up, including pre-silicon emulation or FPGA platforms.
Experience with cellular or wireless modem firmware (LTE, 5G NR).
Familiarity with ARM or similar processor architectures.
Experience applying machine learning to system performance or efficiency problems, including deploying models on resource-constrained hardware.

title: Commercial Lead, New Ventures & Monetization
description:
The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they create the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple and help us leave the world better than we found it.
You will join the Apple Music Commercial team’s growth incubator — a small group that takes 0-to-1 bets on how Apple Music grows — and own the commercial side of the subscriber funnel: how listeners discover what Apple Music is worth, how we invite them in, and how we turn that into a subscription or a new form of revenue. Some of this is sharpening what exists today. More of it is building things that don’t exist yet: new offers, new formats, new business models.
In this role you will develop new monetization constructs and offer formats for listeners who are not yet ready for a full subscription, building the business cases that take ideas from concept to approval and scaled execution. You will own commercial outcomes for non-subscriber listeners end to end, from opportunity sizing and goal-setting to experiment design and readout, partnering closely with Product, Marketing, Editorial, Finance, and Data Science. You will represent the Commercial team with cross-functional leadership and ensure every program launched holds up economically and delivers a better listener experience.
Minimum qualifications: 8+ years of experience in commercial, growth, or business development roles, with meaningful time in subscription media, digital streaming, or consumer apps.
Proven ability to take a commercial initiative from blank page through business case, cross-functional alignment, launch, and measurement readout.
Deep expertise in funnel analysis and experiment design, including the ability to build funnel models from scratch and distinguish a real result from noise.
Strong background in cross-functional collaboration with product, marketing, and data science teams on in-app or digital growth programs.
Demonstrated ability to size market opportunities, set quantitative goals, and be held accountable to commercial outcomes rather than activity metrics.
Track record of communicating complex commercial strategies clearly and concisely to senior audiences in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
Bachelors degree

Familiarity with music industry economics, including how streaming rights and licensing structures interact with consumer offer design.
Skilled in thinking in business model terms, not just campaign terms, with experience designing novel offer formats or revenue constructs.
Hands-on experience working within or alongside editorial teams, bringing a listener-first perspective to commercial program design.
MBA or equivalent advanced degree, valued as a complement to hands-on commercial operating experience rather than a substitute for it.

Here, you'll do more than join something — you'll add something!
We are a team of computer vision and machine learning engineers building real-time perception systems, motion synthesis, and human understanding technologies for current and future Apple products. The VCV org is a centralized applied research and engineering organization responsible for developing real-time on-device Computer Vision and Machine Perception technologies across Apple products. We are looking for engineers with expertise in deep learning-focused computer vision for human understanding, motion synthesis, visual recognition, biometric algorithms, and 3D perception systems.
In this role, you will help design, build, and ship core perception technologies, motion synthesis systems, and human understanding algorithms used by millions of users across Apple's ecosystem.
You will work on cutting-edge computer vision and machine learning problems, developing algorithms and systems that enable natural human-computer interaction. This includes human perception, motion synthesis, biometric recognition, 3D vision, and performance-critical real-time systems.
You will be responsible for developing and optimizing computer vision and machine learning algorithms for human understanding, including pose estimation, gesture recognition, facial analysis, and behavioral modeling. You will build motion synthesis systems and algorithms for realistic human motion generation and animation, design and implement biometric algorithms for secure authentication and identification systems, and create real-time 3D perception and tracking systems for spatial computing and AR/VR applications. As a member of a fast-paced team, you have the unique and rewarding opportunity to shape upcoming products that will delight and inspire millions of people every day.

Experience in deep learning with demonstrated work in at least one area of multimodal systems (e.g. vision, language, video, etc.)
Proficiency in Python and in a modern deep learning framework such as PyTorch or JAX
Experience with rapid prototyping, reproduction, and validation of research ideas
Strong mathematical foundations in machine learning, computer vision, or related fields
Experience with foundation model architectures and training methodologies

description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming phenomenal products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish.
Do you love thinking analytically? Are you passionate about using your financial knowledge to navigate complex challenges? Just as our customers find value in Apple products, the Finance group finds value for both Apple and its shareholders.

Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other’s ideas stronger. title: Senior Engineering Manager, Multilingual AI - Siri
description:
Siri is used by people all over the world, in their own languages on billions of Apple devices. Global Siri makes that possible, working across engineering teams to bring Siri and the Apple Intelligence experiences built around it to users in every supported language and region.
This is a pivotal moment. Siri is evolving from a voice assistant into a deeply personal, agentic AI that understands your personal context, reasons on what's on your screen, and takes action across your apps, all built on Apple's foundation of privacy. Bringing that experience to every language and every culture is one of the hardest and most consequential problems in applied AI today: it requires close integration across large language models, speech technologies, multimodal understanding, agentic evaluation, and the large-scale data and platform systems that tie them together.
We're looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead a multi-team AI engineering organization, at the intersection of feature development, engineering architecture, and global language readiness. You'll define the strategy and execution for how Siri's next-generation intelligence reaches international users, set the technical direction, grow an exceptional group of managers and engineers, and partner with global regional teams to bring these experiences to users worldwide. If you want deep technical challenges, global product impact, and the satisfaction of seeing your work reach people in their own language across the world, this is the right role.
As Senior Engineering Manager for Global Siri, you will lead a group of engineering and machine learning teams, responsible for internationalization architecture, cross-functional integration, and engineering readiness of next-generation Siri and Apple Intelligence features. You'll be accountable for end-to-end outcomes: from defining the technical strategy and scalable ML architecture, through model development, data, and evaluation, to shipping production systems that run on-device and in Apple's Private Cloud Compute.
Your organization's scope will cover the full stack of international language technologies including:
- Language understanding and LLMs: establish multilingual and locale-specific scaling technologies. Work with foundation model and features teams on architecture, model behavior, adaptation, evaluation of intentional experiences, reasoning, and generation, including personal context and on-screen awareness.
- Speech and multimodal input: automatic speech recognition (ASR), text-to-speech (TTS), speaker understanding, and fusion of voice, vision, and text input across languages, accents, and dialects.
- Agentic capabilities: ensuring Siri can reliably take action across apps and services for users worldwide, accounting for regional apps, conventions, and expectations.
- Evaluation and data science: building state-of-the-art multilingual and agentic evaluation that tells us, with rigor, how good Siri is in each market and where to invest next.
- Data and platform: scalable systems for data collection, annotation, synthetic data generation, and language-specific representations and conventions, plus the tooling and pipelines that make launching a new language faster with each release.
You'll partner closely with Siri's Speech, Experience, Platform, and Foundation Model teams, as well as product, design, research, data science, and regional engineering organizations, to turn ambitious goals into shipped products. You'll be a visible leader across Siri and Apple Intelligence, providing regular updates to senior leadership and influencing roadmaps well beyond your own organization.
What you'll do
- Lead and grow a multi-team organization of ML engineers and software engineers, including managing first-line managers and senior technical leaders.
- Set the technical strategy and multi-year engineering plan for bringing Siri and Apple Intelligence capabilities to international markets, and translate it into clear priorities, milestones, and owners.
- Own key decisions on ML architecture and language technologies across Siri products and technologies; shape model and platform requirements through partnership with the teams that own those systems.
- Build scalable, repeatable systems and processes that reduce the cost and time of adding and improving each language, so quality scales with the number of markets rather than against it.
- Establish rigorous, data-driven evaluation for each locale, including agentic and end-to-end evaluation, and use it to guide investment and launch decisions.
- Lead data strategy, including annotation programs, data quality, and the definition of language-specific representations, conventions, and guidelines.
- Partner across Siri and Apple Intelligence, influencing teams throughout the stack so that international is designed in from the start rather than added later.
- Champion modern engineering practices and reusable GenAI-assisted workflows, to accelerate delivery while maintaining high quality and reliability.
- Attract, hire, develop, and retain outstanding talent, and build a team culture of technical excellence, ownership, inclusion, and care.
- Communicate the team’s strategy, engineering decisions, delivery progress, and cross-functional risks clearly to senior leadership and partner organizations.
Minimum qualifications: 10+ years of experience building software and/or machine learning systems, including 5+ years managing engineering teams.
Experience managing managers or leading a multi-team organization, with a track record of developing first-line managers and senior engineers.
Hands-on technical background in software and/or ML engineering, with depth in at least one of: LLM-based products, language technologies, speech systems, or multimodal AI products.
Proven track record of shipping ML-powered products at scale, with a detailed understanding of development, evaluation, integration, and release readiness.
Strong leadership, planning, and prioritization skills, with demonstrated ability to deliver complex, cross-functional programs.
Excellent written and verbal communication, including presenting to executive leadership and working effectively with people across a wide range of backgrounds and technical depth.

title: Senior Human-Centered AI Researcher, Personal Intelligence & Experiences
description:
At Apple, we create intuitive, intelligent experiences that enrich people's lives. We are seeking a Senior Human-Centered AI Researcher to help shape the next generation of software experiences across Apple's ecosystem. As part of our Silicon Engineering group, you will take imaginative and revolutionary ideas and determine how to turn them into reality! You and your team will apply engineering fundamentals and start from scratch if needed, bringing forward-thinking ideas to the real world. Join us, and you will help design products that bring to our customers experiences they’ve never before envisioned!
You will be part of an exciting silicon design group that is responsible for designing state-of-the-art ASICs. We have an extraordinary opportunity for Validation Engineers.
The SoC hardware development team is looking for a motivated engineer to fill a full-time position. The primary role is to engage in power hardware validation and analysis of typical SoC workloads. The analysis of the workloads and their power dissipation will help drive the power optimization efforts to achieve best-in-class power/performance.
Imagine yourself at the center of our SOC design effort, collaborating with all fields, playing a strategic role of getting functional products to millions of customers quickly. You will have the opportunity to integrate and come-up with new ideas, as well as work with a team of industrious engineers. As a member of the SoC power team, you will get involved in the power validation efforts of mobile SoCs.
The main responsibilities of this role are:
- Measure in silicon power dissipation of typical workloads (e.g., video streaming, video recording, etc.), analyze data, and correlate measurements with simulation results.
- Have a close collaboration with design, architecture, systems, and software teams, hence strong communication and teamwork skills are essential.
- Perform silicon power measurements and correlate with simulations/projections.
- Work with multi-functional teams to enable use-case power measurements.
- Improve use-case energy efficiency through tuning of hardware and software settings.
- Improve power measurement infrastructure.
Minimum qualifications: A minimum of a bachelor's degree in relevant field and a minimum of 10 years of relevant industry experience.
Preferred qualifications: We are looking for applicants with phenomenal programming skills and understanding of low-power digital design and power fundamentals, including:
- Expertise on C/Assembly programming and associated tool chains.
- Use of basic lab equipment such as multi-meter units, oscilloscopes, etc.
- Calculations for dynamic and static power in CMOS.
- Strong communication skills and ability to work as a team.

Job Description
Cox Automotive’s Enterprise Platforms Data & Analytics organization owns the pipelines, Snowflake data layers, and governed data products that feed Finance, Sales, Marketing, Service, and the company’s growing portfolio of AI initiatives. Data lands in Snowflake from dozens of enterprise sources through a metadata-driven AWS framework, is modeled into conformed and mart layers, and is exposed to BI tools, downstream applications, and AI agents under strict governance and PII controls.
This engineer is a hands-on technical leader on one of the Data & Analytics delivery pods. You will build and ship production pipelines and governed views, raise the quality bar through validation and peer review, help production support teams resolve complex data incidents, and mentor a mixed onshore and offshore team. The work sits at the point where data engineering meets AI: the datasets you deliver are the foundation for BI today and for AI-assisted analytics tomorrow, and you will use AI-assisted development responsibly to deliver them faster.
WHAT YOU'LL DO:
Main Responsibilities
Design, build, and operate metadata-driven ingestion and egress pipelines that land data from enterprise applications, databases, and third-party APIs into Snowflake, using a shared, configuration-driven AWS framework (serverless compute, orchestration, change data capture, object storage, metadata registries, and infrastructure-as-code)
Own end-to-end delivery of features from refined requirement to production: source onboarding, raw-to-hub modeling, SQL transformations, validation, and release through a controlled multi-environment CI/CD flow
Build governed consumption layers in Snowflake: conformed and base views, business-specific models, marts, and role-based access, with PII masking and data-quality verification shipped alongside every view
Extend and harden shared libraries and frameworks (SLA monitoring, asset registration, alerting, connection management, and code generation) so new sources onboard through configuration rather than custom code
Define and enforce data-quality, reconciliation, and peer-validation standards, including row-count, orphan, duplicate, and freshness checks that gate every promotion to production
Lead production readiness and support escalations alongside production support teams: diagnose stale or partially loaded tables, replication and ingestion failures, role and permission regressions, authentication changes, and month-end reporting issues
Drive the migration of legacy code into domain-owned repositories with clear ownership, CI/CD, and catalog metadata
Use AI-assisted development (coding assistants, spec-driven development, reusable skills) to raise throughput without lowering the review and testing bar, and help formalize guardrails for the team
Partner with Product Owners, architects, and consuming business and AI teams to translate business questions into reliable, documented, governed datasets that serve both BI and AI workloads
Mentor junior and offshore engineers, review pull requests against architecture and design standards, and contribute to shared standards for ingestion, modeling, governance, and cataloging
Produce documentation, runbooks, and operational playbooks, and keep work items, features, and dependencies accurate for the Release Train
WHO YOU ARE:
Required Skills
Applicants must currently be authorized to work in the United States for any employer without current or future sponsorship. No OPT, CPT, STEM/OPT or visa sponsorship now or in future.
Must be located in Atlanta GA or be willing to relocate at own expense

Job Description:
Forensic Accounting Managing Director - Litigation Support & Economic Damages
Essential Job Functions:
Economic Damages, Litigation & Forensic Analysis:
Lead complex economic damages and financial analyses in commercial disputes, including lost profits, breach of contract, intellectual property, business interruption, shareholder and other business disputes.
Develop, review, and defend sophisticated damages, valuation, and financial models using financial statements, transaction-level data, forecasts, market information, and other relevant evidence.
Evaluate opposing expert analyses, damages theories, assumptions, and methodologies; identify strengths, weaknesses, and alternative approaches.
Lead litigation support engagements from early case assessment through expert reports, depositions, arbitration, and trial, including preparation of expert exhibits and demonstratives.
Apply forensic accounting and investigative techniques where disputes involve allegations of fraud, accounting irregularities, asset tracing, or other complex financial issues.
Use quantitative analysis and data analytics to support damages calculations, forensic investigations, post-acquisition disputes, and other litigation-related inquiries.
Client & Engagement Management:
Conduct engagements in compliance with applicable professional, legal, regulatory, and firm requirements.
Manage a broad spectrum of matters involving investigations, litigation support, post-acquisition disputes, and insurance claims.
Lead a broad spectrum of matters involving economic damages, litigation support, forensic accounting investigations, post-acquisition disputes, and other complex financial disputes.
Position the team for successful engagement execution, quality results, and client satisfaction by clearly working within project parameters, managing resources and processes, and anticipating/resolving issues.
Serve as a senior advisor to clients and counsel, translating complex financial and accounting issues into clear, defensible analyses and practical litigation strategies.
Lead engagement execution, including scope, workplan, staffing, budgets, quality, risk management, expert-report development, and client satisfaction.
Manage engagement setup and completion activities, including conflicts, engagement letters, billing, collections, and other engagement administration.
Develop and maintain trusted relationships with outside counsel, in-house legal teams, executives, and other senior client stakeholders.
Recruit, mentor, and develop professionals across the damages and broader Disputes & Investigations team, including development of future expert witnesses.
Business Development:
Originate and expand economic damages and litigation support engagements through an established network of law firms, corporate clients, and referral relationships.
Build Crowe’s market position in economic damages and litigation support, with an expectation of developing into or continuing as a recognized testifying expert.
Identify opportunities to expand existing client relationships and cross-sell Crowe capabilities across forensic accounting, investigations, digital forensics, post-acquisition disputes, and other Advisory services.
Collaborate with Crowe partners and leaders across Advisory to identify disputes, litigation, and expert-services opportunities within existing client relationships.
Maintain and expand an external network of attorneys, experts, corporate decision-makers, and industry contacts to generate opportunities and strengthen Crowe’s brand in the disputes market.
Represent Crowe through relevant legal, accounting, damages, and industry organizations, conferences, CLE/CPE programs, publications, and other thought-leadership activities.
Develop a recognized area of expertise within economic damages and litigation support and contribute to Crowe industry and market initiatives.
Reporting & Communication:
Draft, review, and support expert reports, rebuttal reports, declarations, presentations, and trial demonstratives that clearly communicate complex damages and financial analyses.
Present complex financial concepts and conclusions to attorneys, executives, boards, arbitrators, judges, and juries in a clear and credible manner.
Serve as a senior client and counsel contact and, based on experience, provide deposition, arbitration, and trial testimony as an expert witness.
Basic Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business, or a related quantitative field required; advanced degree is a plus.
CPA, CFA, CFF, ABV, CVA, CFE, or other relevant professional credential strongly preferred. A CPA is preferred for candidates whose expert work is primarily accounting-based.
Minimum of ten (10) years of progressive experience in economic damages, litigation support, forensic accounting, valuation, dispute advisory, or related professional services, including significant responsibility for complex matters.
Significant professional-services experience with demonstrated responsibility for law-firm and client relationships, engagement leadership, team development, and financial performance.
Deep knowledge of economic damages methodologies and financial analysis, with experience in areas such as lost profits, breach of contract, intellectual property, business valuation, business interruption, shareholder disputes, or other complex commercial litigation.
Demonstrated experience developing or managing complex damages models and contributing substantially to expert reports, rebuttal analyses, deposition preparation, arbitration, and trial. Prior expert testimony is strongly preferred, but candidates with substantial second-chair or supporting-expert experience and a clear trajectory toward testimony will be considered.
Proven ability to manage multiple complex engagements simultaneously, including scope, budgets, staffing, deliverables, expert deadlines, risk management, and client/counsel expectations.
Demonstrated business development success, including an established network of attorneys and/or corporate relationships, a track record of originating or expanding engagements, and the ability to build a sustainable book of business at Crowe.
Strong leadership and people-management experience, including supervising, mentoring, developing, and evaluating professionals and building teams capable of supporting complex expert matters.
Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to evaluate incomplete or conflicting financial evidence and develop independent, defensible conclusions.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience communicating complex damages and financial analyses to legal counsel, senior executives, and other sophisticated stakeholders.
Experience analyzing large and complex financial and transactional data sets and using those analyses to support damages opinions, forensic conclusions, or litigation strategy.
Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint; experience with financial modeling, data analytics, and litigation-support tools is preferred.
Ability to travel and work additional hours as required by client needs, expert-report deadlines, depositions, arbitrations, and trials.

Our Central Operations team, part of New Verticals Strategy & Operations, is re-inventing how consumers shop grocery, convenience, alcohol and retail by making every store’s digital shelf match the physical shelf. We do this by onboarding new data sources that improve selection coverage, price accuracy, inventory accuracy, and the location data that helps Dashers find the store and the item. When these get better, consumers see what they want at the right price and receive it with fewer substitutions and refunds, Dashers shop and navigate faster, and merchants sell more. You will partner with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to build AI-enabled tooling, launch operational processes at scale, own metrics, and pull operational and product levers across our Grocery, Convenience, Alcohol and Retail businesses.
About the Role
We are looking to hire a Manager to own how we onboard new data sources, external and internal, onto our ecosystem. Externally, you will bring on inventory and syndicated data providers, CPG branded data, in-store robotics companies, and other software and technology partners. Internally, you will find new ways to leverage the data we already have. Together, these sources align the physical inventory of brick-and-mortar stores with the digital inventory. You will also explore how these assets could grow into an inventory-as-a-service solution. You will partner with Machine Learning, Engineering, Product, Data Science, and Commercial teams. title: Mechanical Engineer - Structural Simulation
description:
About the Team
DoorDash Labs is the hardware and autonomy innovation engine at DoorDash. We design, build, and deploy custom robotics and autonomous delivery systems designed to operate safely, efficiently, and reliably in urban environments. We are currently kicking off development on our clean-sheet, next-generation robot platform—rethinking the mobility foundation from first principles to dramatically improve efficiency, payload dynamics, and service lifetime.
About the Role
As a Senior Structural Simulation Engineer (Level IC5) , you will be the foundational structural analysis authority for DoorDash Labs. You will own structural finite element analysis (FEA) across our next-generation robotic platform, working directly on core vehicle architecture—including chassis systems, suspension, closures, and sensor enclosures.
This role will be heavily focused on  future-forward designs starting from the early concept phase. In your first 90 days, you will drive our architectural exploration, define early vehicle load cases, and make strategic software ecosystem decisions (including standardizing and driving our commercial commitments around simulation tools). As development advances, you will shift from rapid concept modeling to production-intent structural refinement and physical test-to-simulation correlation.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will:
Build From Day Zero: Lead structural concept validation for a ground-up robotic platform, running high-velocity trade studies alongside chassis, suspension, and closures engineers.
Define Our Tooling & Workflows: Evaluate, select, and operationalize our primary CAE/FEA software tech stack (with an emphasis on ANSYS-based suites), negotiating capabilities and technical fit directly with vendors.
Establish Load Cases & Criteria: Formulate first-principles structural load cases, fatigue histories, stiffness benchmarks, and failure criteria for dynamic ground vehicle environments where little historical data exists.
Simulate Critical Vehicle Subsystems: Execute complex static, dynamic, modal, durability, and fatigue analyses on structural enclosures, cast and sheet-metal subframes, linkages, and moving mechanisms.
Drive Test-Simulation Correlation: Partner with physical test teams to correlate strain gauge, modal shaker, and dynamic field testing data back into simulation models to maximize predictive accuracy.
Influence Primary Architecture: Act as the math-first checkpoint for mechanical design decisions, steering CAD geometry toward optimized strength-to-weight ratios before parts hit prototype tooling.
We’re excited about you because:
Deep Structural Domain Expertise: You bring 7+ years of hands-on structural FEA and mechanical simulation experience (or an advanced degree—MS/PhD—with 4+ years) focused on structural integrity, stiffness, fatigue life, and dynamic loading.
Vehicle & Robotics Systems Background: You have a demonstrated track record analyzing moving vehicle architectures—such as automotive body-in-white (BIW), chassis frames, suspensions, structural battery enclosures, robotics, drones, or high-performance mobility platforms.
Software Mastery (ANSYS Preferred): You are an advanced user of industry-standard finite element solvers (ANSYS Mechanical/Workbench strongly preferred; Abaqus, OptiStruct/HyperMesh, or LS-DYNA considered) and understand solver theory, element formulations, and convergence troubleshooting.
First-Principles Mechanical Rigor: You possess strong mathematical and classical mechanics fundamentals; you don’t just hit "solve," but can gut-check stress distributions and shear loads with hand calculations.
Ambiguity & Green-Field Ownership: You thrive in early-stage product definitions where requirements are fluid, documentation is sparse, and decisions must be made quickly with high technical conviction.
Cross-Functional Communication: You clearly translate complex FEA stress tensors, fatigue curves, and deflection limits into actionable design guidance for mechanical design engineers and leadership.
Nice to Haves:
Prior experience establishing or transitioning a company’s CAE software stack from scratch.
Background in topology optimization, lightweighting cast/extruded aluminum structures, or composite material modeling.
Direct experience running durability and fatigue analysis on systems subject to rough-road, curb-strike, or cyclic vibrational abuse.
Working familiarity with CAD tools (e.g., NX, SolidWorks, or Creo) for rapid geometry defeature and design iteration.

title: Research Operations Manager
location: San Francisco, CA ; Sunnyvale, CA; New York, NY
description:
About the Team
DoorDash’s mission is to grow and empower local economies. By building intelligent, last-mile delivery technology for local cities, DoorDash connects people with the local businesses they care about — helping grow businesses and the communities that support those businesses. At DoorDash, there are three audiences that are at the core of every decision we make - our Consumers, Merchants, and Couriers. The Research team has a direct link to uncover the unmet needs and pain points of each of these audiences. We bring their voices into the business in order to help set the strategic vision for all of DoorDash’s current and future products.
About the Role
We're looking for a Research Operations Manager to be the operational backbone of our research team, and a driving force behind DoorDash's commitment to customer obsession. Every great product decision starts with a real voice: a Dasher, a merchant, a customer. You'll own the systems, tools, vendors, and AI-powered processes that get those voices in front of the people building for them, faster and at greater scale. You'll also champion a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement, so the research practice keeps getting better along with our understanding of the people we serve. This is a high-impact role at the intersection of research, operations, and technology, built for someone who sees friction before it's surfaced and treats it as theirs to solve.
What You'll Do
Vendor & Procurement Management : Own the end-to-end lifecycle of research vendor relationships — from sourcing and evaluation through contract negotiation, onboarding, and ongoing performance review. You'll manage relationships with research tool providers, recruiting agencies, transcription and analysis services, and other third-party partners. You'll establish clear SLAs, hold vendors accountable, and continuously evaluate the market for better options.
Budget Management:  Own the research team's budget: track spend, forecast needs, manage purchase orders, and ensure resources are allocated to the highest-impact work. You'll build visibility and reporting so research leaders can make informed investment decisions, and you'll identify opportunities to optimize spend without sacrificing research quality.
Participant Recruiting Lead the strategy and execution of participant recruiting across studies — managing panels, recruiting vendors, and internal databases to ensure the team has access to the right participants at the right time. You'll develop screeners, coordinate scheduling, manage incentives and compliance, and build systems that make recruiting faster and less effort-intensive for researchers.
AI-Powered Research Tooling: Partner with researchers, engineering, design to evaluate, build, maintain, and scale AI-based tools that accelerate the research process, from automated synthesis and analysis pipelines to intelligent tagging, search, and knowledge management. You'll bring a practical, iterative approach: shipping tools that solve real problems, gathering feedback, and improving them over time.
Culture of Experimentation Be a visible champion for experimentation within the research team. This means creating the conditions (psychological safety, lightweight processes, shared frameworks) that make it easy for researchers to try new methods, tools, and approaches. You'll run retrospectives, document and share learnings, and help the team build an institutional memory around what works.
Operations & Scalability Design and maintain the operational infrastructure that keeps the research practice running smoothly: research repositories, documentation standards, onboarding materials, team rituals, and the tooling stack. As the team and its ambitions grow, you'll proactively identify bottlenecks and build solutions before they become problems. You will also partner across brands/regions to extend research operations infrastructure globally, adapting for local legal and market requirements.
What We're Looking For
7+ years of experience in research operations, UX operations, or a closely related role
Experience managing contractors or full-time employees, including setting priorities, providing feedback, supporting development, and ensuring delivery
Demonstrated experience managing research vendors and procurement processes
Experience owning and forecasting operational or project budgets
Experience with research repositories and recruiting platforms (UserTesting, Qualtrics, etc.)
Familiarity with prompt engineering or working with LLMs in a research or operations context. You don't need to code, but you're excited to build tools using AI and have strong intuitions about what to build and when
A systems thinker who can zoom out to see inefficiencies and zoom in to fix them
Strong communicator who can influence without authority and build trust across research, product, and engineering teams
High degree of self-direction. You spot problems before they're surfaced to you and move quickly to address them
Why This Role
Research Operations is often the difference between a research team that produces insights and one that produces impact. In this role, you'll have real ownership, a team that values your craft, and the opportunity to shape how a research practice operates at scale, including on the frontier of AI-assisted research.
Why You’ll Love Working at DoorDash
We are leaders – Leadership is not limited to our management team. It’s something everyone at DoorDash embraces and embodies.
We are operators – We believe the only way to predict the future is to build it. Creating solutions to lead our company and our industry is what we do on every project, every day.
We are learners – Everyone here is continually learning on the job, no matter if we’ve been in a role for one year or one minute. We are committed to learning and implementing what is best for our customers, merchants, and dashers.
We are one team – The magic of DoorDash is our people, together making our inspiring goals attainable and driving us to greater heights.

description:
About the Team
DashMart is a local-fulfillment center owned and operated by DoorDash, offering customers household essentials and other items to their doorsteps with speed, reliability, and quality. Customers order their convenience, grocery, retail, and prepared foods in the DoorDash app, and our team members fulfill orders in a real, brick-and-mortar store for Dashers to deliver. We’re open early and close late - some sites even run 24/7!
About the Role
DashMart is looking for a motivated and experienced individual that excels in fast-paced, physical environments and is excited to roll up their sleeves and actively engage in day-to-day operations.  In this role, you will work within a local fulfillment center supporting Site Management running great shifts, and delegating tasks. As a Shift Lead, you will have shift responsibility for fulfilling orders in a warehouse environment and maintaining inventory, and in some locations, this involves preparing food in a light-prep kitchen.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Be an Owner: Take ownership of your assigned shifts, including warehouse and kitchen processes, safety/cleanliness, quality, and training. Maintain accountability for inventory, equipment, and other company assets to ensure they are properly handled, stored, and protected from loss or theft.
Delight Customers: Ensure customer orders are delivered with high quality by executing orders accurately, communicating with customers when issues arise, and making sure Dasher pickups go smoothly.
Lead: Guide Operations Associates through their shift by ensuring the team works safely and productively and serving as the point of escalation for daily operations.
One Team One Fight: Support operations in both the warehouse and kitchen, assist with day-to-day tasks, and lead by example. You will be expected to engage in professional and respectful interactions with team members and customers, ensuring a positive and safe atmosphere in the warehouse while providing a high-quality experience for our customers.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Lead: Recruit, lead, coach & retain a high-performing team of Shift Leads (3+) and Operations Associates (6+). Set your team up for success to work safely and productively. About the Team
The Strategic Inside Sales team drives DoorDash’s growth by acquiring high-impact restaurant brands across key markets. The team focuses on higher-value and more complex opportunities, working with local and regional operators whose scale meaningfully shapes the marketplace.
Through disciplined execution, thoughtful prioritization, and a consultative sales approach, Strategic Inside Sales expands DoorDash’s merchant ecosystem while helping restaurant partners understand how DoorDash’s platform and solutions can support their growth.
About the Role
As a Strategic Account Executive (SAE), you will acquire high-value restaurant partners in DoorDash’s most strategic markets. You’ll own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and prioritization through discovery, negotiation, and close, while managing a high-volume portfolio of opportunities with varying levels of complexity and potential impact.
Success in this role requires more than activity. You’ll use data, technology, AI-enabled tools, and strong business judgment to determine where to spend your time, how to approach each opportunity, and how to navigate more nuanced commercial conversations.
You’ll have autonomy over your day and pipeline while being accountable for clear activity, pipeline, and revenue outcomes. You’ll also work cross-functionally to structure deals, solve merchant challenges, and continuously improve how we sell.
We expect this role to be flexible, with a mix of remote and in-office work. You will need the ability to travel as needed for trainings, offsites, team-building events, and other business needs.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Own higher-value new business acquisition: Prospect, qualify, pitch, negotiate, and close strategically important restaurant partners, including multi-location opportunities.
Prioritize for impact: Manage a large portfolio of prospects and opportunities while using data and business judgment to focus time on the highest-value opportunities.
Run the full sales cycle: Lead merchants from initial outreach and discovery through negotiation and close, adapting your strategy based on merchant needs and deal complexity.
Navigate commercial conversations: Understand merchant economics, evaluate potential deal structures, and negotiate intentionally within established financial guardrails.
Build and manage pipeline: Maintain disciplined outbound activity across calls, emails, and follow-ups while creating and advancing sufficient pipeline to consistently deliver against goals.
Leverage technology and AI: Use CRM, sequencing, automation, AI-enabled tools, and other sales technology to research accounts, prepare for conversations, improve productivity, and make better decisions.

Continuously improve your craft: Use performance data, coaching, and experimentation to identify gaps, refine your approach, and adapt quickly when a strategy isn't working.
Raise the bar for the team: Share successful approaches, tools, and learnings that can improve execution beyond your individual book of business.
Represent DoorDash at a high standard: Deliver a thoughtful merchant experience that establishes credibility and creates the foundation for a long-term partnership.

3+ years of inside sales or B2B sales experience, including demonstrated success in a closing role.
A track record of meeting or exceeding quota in a fast-paced, high-volume sales environment.

Strong prospecting, discovery, objection-handling, negotiation, and closing skills.
Strong business judgment and the ability to make decisions with incomplete information.
A high level of ownership and comfort independently diagnosing problems and determining next steps.
A data-driven approach to understanding your performance and identifying opportunities to improve.
Experience using CRM and sales technology such as Salesforce, Outreach, Sales Navigator, or similar tools.
Curiosity and willingness to adopt emerging technology, including AI, to improve productivity and sales effectiveness.
A growth mindset and demonstrated ability to incorporate coaching, test new approaches, and adapt quickly.

At DoorDash we are redefining what it means to be a designer. We are building toward a team of makers, builders, and doers. Between 2005 and 2015, "web designer" became "product designer" and the scope widened. The same shift is happening now, as LLMs expand that scope again, toward strategy on one end and direct execution on the other.
